source_text: Sanguis in altare; pellis et fimus extra castra comburuntur. Christus extra portam passus. Nos opprobrium eius portamus.
pass_a_gloss: Blood on altar; hide and dung outside camp are-burned. Christ outside gate having-suffered. We reproach his we-carry.
pass_b_english: Blood goes to the altar; hide and dung are burned [[outside the camp >> Bible:Leviticus 4:11-12]]. So Christ [[suffered outside the gate >> Bible:Hebrews 13:12]]. We bear his reproach.
